description: A MAC address lookup that names the manufacturer — and says when there isn't one. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

address.description: A MAC address in any common form — 'D8:3A:DD:11:22:33', 'd8-3a-dd-11-22-33', 'D83A.DD11.2233' or 'd83add112233'. An EUI-64 (16 hex digits) works too, and so does a bare 24-, 28- or 36-bit prefix on its own if that is all you have.

name: mac_address_lookup
title: MAC Address Lookup
